svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT Z detailed field guide
svg.desc: Agent Z applies a fixed 100-question policy to evidence and produces a versioned advisory scorecard. This image also lists the exact folder, example prompt, CLI surfaces, five or six process steps, and role boundary.
svg.text: Review this evidence against the fixed policy.
Score only supported answers and show the delta.
Agent Z asks 100 fixed questions across 10 categories.
A scorecard is advisory evidence; it does not accept a task.
